title: GenStone vs Tritan
description: Which faux stone is the right choice for your project? If you're shopping Tritan, don't make your final decision before seeing this guide.
text: Gen Stone vs Tritan "From a distance it looks really nice, but it's flawed when you get up close" -Amy This focus group was assembled for the purpose of comparing and contrasting different faux stone producers. Some of the criteria to judge each product was appearance, material, and installation process. Not a single person on this focus group was hand-picked. Every individual had not heard or seen any of the products used. These are their personal, authentic opinions. Request Quote Project Calculator https://vimeo.com/712998658 vs The Difference is in the Details Tritan GenStone Material Composition Tritan BP is made from high density polyurethane Proprietary blend of materials sourced in the USA resulting in a durable woodlike panel Installation Process Install individual panels from bottom to top. Screws and adhesive hold them in place. Additional touch up work is required at the end Install all GenStone panels inside or outside with fasteners along the shiplap and adhesive on the back of each piece System Tritan BP has panels, corners, outlet covers, and a touch up kit The GenStone Made Easy System contains panels, inside and outside corners, trim, ledgers, wall caps and finished edge pieces Warranty Tritan BP requires you to take some time to fill out a registration form for warranty GenStone orders come with a 25 year warranty Cost per SQFT Tritan BP is $13-$17 per SQFT GenStone is $13 to $18 per SQFT before any project promotions which can save as much as 50% over the cost of real stone Support Tritan BP can be contacted through their phone number listed on their website GenStone Project Coordinators are available at no additional cost to assist with color selection, estimates and questions during installation Tritan Tritan BP is a manufacturer and distributor of polyurethane products with an emphasis on faux siding although they cover other products as well. Tritan has been reformulating raw materials to develop the most cost-effective product while not limiting installation possibilities. GenStone Established in 2003, GenStone manufacturers a full collection of stone and brick colors including easy to install panels, corners, ledgers, trim, pillars and columns.
